svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make three. Base: 260 x 260 x 10 mm plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 28 mm stake holes on the cross centre line, 85 mm each side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of the middle, to match the pad.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leg lugs: two 100 x 90 x 10 mm plates standing on the base,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred, 17 mm apart (inside faces), running toward the well.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 21 mm pin hole through both, 60 mm above the base top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the two lugs together after welding so the holes line up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chain eye fins: two 60 x 45 x 12 mm plates on the well side,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centres 50 mm in from the edge and 60 mm either side, each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: turned to point along its spread chain; 20 mm hole 25 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fillet weld 6 mm all round; galvanise after welding.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the leg tongue (16 mm) slides between the lugs and a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 mm pin goes through all three holes by hand.
